湾区住久了，账单也该重算：水电、宽带与手机年度复核: An annual Bay Area household bill review: energy, internet, and phone
用过去 12 个月的真实支出，决定换费率、申请减免还是保持现状: Use 12 months of actual spending to decide whether to change plans, apply for assistance, or stay put
适合已经开户、却多年没重新比较费用的家庭。从全年账单与用量复盘，到 CARE、F: For households with established accounts that have not compared costs in years. Review spending and usage, check CARE, FERA, efficiency services, separate LifeLine renewals, and SFPUC water eligibility, then verify the changes on later bills.
远程工作、添置电车或家庭人数变化的人: People whose remote work, EV ownership, or household size has changed
官方项目资料核验于 2026 年 10 月 2 日。下列复核顺序、时间预算和算例: Official program information checked October 2, 2026. The review sequence, time budget, and calculations below are editorial suggestions. Your provider must assess current household and account information; approval and savings are not guaranteed.
PG&E：按实际用量比较费率: PG&E: Compare plans using actual usage
费率比较、分时、电车与电气化住宅方案的官方入口。: Official entry point for rate comparisons, time-of-use, EV, and electric-home plans.
核对折扣、家庭人数与当期收入表，向实际公用事业公司申请。: Check discounts, household size, and current income tables; apply through your utility.
核对免费节能服务及公用事业公司联系入口。: Check no-cost efficiency services and utility contacts.
核对每户电话优惠限制与资格申请资料。: Check household limits for discounted phone service and eligibility information.
CPUC：2026 LifeLine 州与联邦流程: CPUC: State and federal LifeLine processes in 2026
2026 年 2 月起两项计划须分别申请、分别续期。: From February 2026, the two programs require separate enrollment and renewal.
核对账户类型、收入、现场入口、处理时间与重新申请要求。: Check account types, income requirements, in-person access, processing time, and reapplication.
7 月官方声明确认继续提供价格、促销期、速度与流量信息；本文不解读各项规则生效日: The July statement confirms continued pricing, introductory-rate, speed, and data information; this guide does not interpret individual rule effective dates.
这篇适合“每月自动扣款都正常，但越来越贵”的家庭。编辑建议一年做一次，另在添置电: This is for households whose automatic payments work but keep growing. Review once a year, and again after adding an EV, starting remote work, losing a housemate, or reaching a promotional expiry. Look for workable changes instead of chasing every advertised minimum.
先整理一年的账单与用量: Start with a year of bills and usage
编辑建议先用 45 分钟整理，再用 30 分钟联系服务商；这只是工作量预算。涉及: As an editorial planning estimate, allow 45 minutes to gather records and 30 minutes to contact providers. Identity checks, home assessments, and installations need their own appointments.
把电、燃气、水、污水、宽带和每条手机线路各列一行：实际公司、户名、服务地址、当前: Make one row each for electricity, gas, water, sewer, broadband, and every mobile line: provider, account holder, service address, plan, autopay method, discount expiry, and rented equipment. Mark landlord-allocated water charges as an indirect account and ask which original bill you can inspect.
下载过去 12 个月账单，分别记总金额和用量。电看 kWh，燃气看 therms: Download the past 12 months of bills and record both totals and consumption. Track electricity in kWh, gas in therms, and water in the unit on the bill. Higher totals do not by themselves show a rate increase; new devices, billing days, and household size can change the comparison.
只比较同样服务范围的数字: Compare the same scope of service
先把常规费用、一次性费用和欠款补缴分开，再比较。客服给出预计节省时，请确认是否包: Separate recurring charges, one-time fees, and arrears before comparing. Ask whether projected savings include all bill components, taxes, fixed charges, and existing discounts. A reduction in one line is not the same as a lower total bill.
电与燃气：比较费率，再核对援助: Electricity and gas: Compare rates and check assistance
在官方 Rate Plans 页选择按实际用量比较并登录自己的账户。保存当前方案: Choose the actual-usage comparison on the official Rate Plans page and sign into your account. Save the current plan, candidate plan, and estimate date; use its tariff links for current rates.
看到分时或电车方案时，先写出家里确实能移动的用电：洗衣、充电或其他大用量设备。编: For time-of-use or EV plans, list consumption you can actually shift, such as laundry or charging. Compare against your real routine and retain unavoidable cooking or caregiving demand rather than assuming a schedule you will not follow.
如果过去一年只有部分月份有电车、太阳能或热泵，历史用量未必代表下一年。切换前问服: If an EV, solar system, or heat pump was present for only part of last year, historical usage may not represent next year. Ask how much data the estimate uses, whether it accounts for new equipment, when a switch takes effect, when another change is allowed, and which existing terms would be lost.
PG&E 的比较工具只用于对应账户。若账单来自其他市政公用事业或有其他供电项目，: PG&E's comparison applies to the relevant PG&E account. For municipal utilities or other supply programs, ask the provider on your bill about its plans and assistance rather than applying PG&E rates, discount percentages, or eligibility outcomes.
CPUC 当前 CARE 页面说明：符合资格者可获得电费约 30%–35%、燃气: The current CPUC CARE page describes approximately 30–35% electricity and 20% gas discounts for qualifying customers, subject to the utility's applicable rules. The checked income table runs June 1, 2026–May 31, 2027; listed public-assistance programs may provide another eligibility route.
CARE 不符合时，再看 FERA，不自行判断“收入差一点就没帮助”。CPUC: If CARE does not fit, check FERA. CPUC lists an 18% electricity discount through designated utilities including PG&E, and the 2026–2027 table includes one- and two-person households. Use current rules and actual household information rather than an old assumption that three people are required.
从 CPUC 进入 CARE / FERA 申请单位: Find your CARE / FERA application provider
先核对当期家庭人数和收入口径，再使用页面中的本公司链接或联系电话。账单减免与费用: Check the current household-size and income definitions, then use your utility's link or phone number on this page. Distinguish assistance from housemate cost sharing; one person's wages do not establish household eligibility.
如果问题是房屋漏风或旧设备耗能，另查 Energy Savings Assist: For drafts or inefficient equipment, separately check Energy Savings Assistance. CPUC lists no-cost efficiency measures for qualifying households, including sealing and insulation. This is not a promise to reimburse an appliance bought first; start with the utility assessment process.
租客先确认房屋与施工条件: Renters: clarify property and installation conditions
询问项目人员是否适用你的房屋类型、需要谁同意、是否需房东或物业配合入户。即使收入: Ask program staff whether your housing type is covered, whose consent is needed, and whether the owner or manager must arrange entry. Obtain the actual scope and schedule before counting an unapproved measure as a household saving.
宽带与手机：按全年成本比较: Internet and phone: Compare full-year costs
宽带先用完整地址和单元号向服务商确认可安装，再比较方案。FCC 2026 年说明: First confirm installation at the complete address and unit. The FCC's 2026 statement retains pricing, introductory-rate, speed, and data information. Find Broadband Facts on the provider's site, then separately ask about equipment, installation, autopay conditions, and the post-promotion price.
编辑算例，非真实报价：A 前 6 个月 $40、后 6 个月 $70，加设备每月: Illustration, not a live offer: A charges $40 for six months, $70 for six months, $10 monthly for equipment, and $50 installation: $830 in year one. B costs $60 monthly with equipment included and no installation fee: $720. Under these assumptions A costs $110 more; recalculate year two separately.
向当前宽带商问“现有客户能转的方案”，向新公司问“这个地址的新客户资格”。把合同: Ask your current ISP which plans existing customers can switch to, and a new ISP whether this address qualifies for its offer. Record contract length, cancellation fees, equipment returns, and final-bill handling. Confirm the replacement works before ending the old service, and include any overlap cost.
手机按全家所有线路加总：服务费、分期手机、保险、附加订阅和国际使用需求分别列出。: Total all household mobile lines and separate service, device installments, insurance, subscriptions, and international needs. Before removing a line or switching, get written details on unpaid devices and remaining promotional credits. Test coverage at home, work, and usual routes before a long commitment.
California LifeLine 是符合资格家庭的电话服务优惠。官方限制通: California LifeLine discounts eligible households' phone service. Its general rule is one discounted phone service per household, choosing home or mobile service; program staff assess specific exceptions. It is not automatically one discounted line per person or the same as an ordinary carrier promotion.
CPUC 确认自 2026 年 2 月 1 日起，California Life: CPUC confirms separate California LifeLine and federal Lifeline enrollment and renewal from February 1, 2026. Existing participants follow their annual renewal requests. Track the two statuses separately; finishing one does not complete both.
从 CPUC 页面进入当前项目网站，核对参与公司、家庭定义及所需材料；已有服务者: Follow CPUC's current program links to check participating providers, household definitions, and documents. Existing subscribers should confirm renewal status and number-transfer arrangements with their participating provider.
水费：按账户类型核对资格: Water: Check eligibility for your account type
水费按实际账单单位查，不按邮寄城市名猜。以 SFPUC 为例，CAP 可能减免: Use the actual billing utility for water assistance. SFPUC CAP may discount 25% or 40%, but requires the applicant's sole SFPUC water/sewer account, full-time residence, an individually metered single-family residential account, non-dependent tax status, and qualifying household income. Shared building meters or allocated charges cannot simply use these rules.
SFPUC CAP：网上或现场申请: SFPUC CAP: Apply online or in person
官方页提供网上与邮寄方式，现场入口为 525 Golden Gate Avenu: The official page offers online and mail applications and a customer counter on the first floor of 525 Golden Gate Avenue. It states roughly 3–4 weeks to process, discounts from the first full approved billing cycle, and reapplication after 36 months. Check counter hours before visiting.
不获批、共表或材料不齐时: If denied, jointly metered, or missing documents
先让机构说明具体原因：收入、账户类型、证明还是现有申请状态。水费共表者向物业问分: Ask which issue prevents approval: income, account type, evidence, or application status. For shared water meters, request the allocation details from management. Ask the provider separately about payment arrangements for overdue bills; a pending assistance application does not mean payments are paused.
落实变更，并检查后续账单: Make the changes and check later bills
给客服的一段复核请求: A request to send your provider
我正在复核家庭年度支出。请按我的服务地址与现有客户身份确认：当前方案和优惠何时结: I am reviewing our annual household spending. For my service address and existing-customer status, please confirm when my current plan or discounts end, eligible replacement plans, all fixed/equipment/one-time charges, effective dates, and any assistance or renewal steps. Please provide the offer and confirmation number in writing so I can compare full-year costs before deciding.
最后只挑一到两项收益最清楚、执行最容易的变化。设提醒检查变更后的首个完整账单及再: Choose one or two changes with the clearest benefit and easiest execution. Check the first full bill after the change and the following bill for plan, equipment charges, discounts, and service. Set an editorially suggested reminder 30 days before promotions end, and record only bill-confirmed differences as actual savings.
